data.name: Title
data.override: Turning the dial on Schedule makes a temporary change

data_description.panel: Untick to keep using a panel_custom panel from configuration.yaml instead. It also adds the receiver sensor the panel follows the receiver through.
data_description.url_path: The panel opens at this address, e.g. heating for /heating. Dashboard buttons link to it.
data_description.sidebar: Without it, the panel opens only from a link, such as a dashboard button. Anyone with the link can still open it.
data_description.name: Shown above the dial, and in the sidebar.
data_description.radiators: Each valve's battery and valve position sensors are found on its device. The list uses each valve's name without words like "radiator" or "TRV" at the end: rename the valve in Home Assistant to change it.
data_description.receiver_entity: Only used for basic details if the receiver sensor has nothing yet. Blank: found from the topic.
data_description.away: Keeps the house at a low temperature until you're back.

tpi.title: TPI boiler control
tpi.description: TPI gives the boiler a share of each cycle, more the further the room is below the target. It works by nudging the receiver's temperature either side of the target while the receiver runs its schedule, so if Home Assistant stops, the receiver keeps the room within the margin. It only runs on Schedule. Run it from one Home Assistant only.

data.prompt_start: Start promptly at a new schedule slot

data_description.coef_int: Share of a cycle per degree the room is below the target. 0.6: 1° below runs the boiler 60% of each cycle.
data_description.coef_ext: Share of a cycle per degree it's colder outside than the target, to make up for heat lost outdoors.
data_description.margin_on: TPI writes the target plus this to run the boiler. Keep it well clear of the room (3° by default): Hive's own control stops early as the room nears its setpoint.
data_description.margin_off: TPI writes the target minus this to rest the boiler.
data_description.min_off_minutes: At least 5: Hive keeps a 5-minute gap between two runs anyway.
data_description.prompt_start: When a slot begins and the room needs only a little heat, run the boiler for the shortest run straight away instead of waiting a cycle for it to add up. The extra is taken off the next cycle.

error.min_times: The shortest run and rest together must fit in one cycle.
error.url_path_invalid: Use lower-case letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. heating.
error.url_path_reserved: Home Assistant already uses that address. Choose another one.
error.url_path_taken: Another receiver's panel already has that address.
